topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: The sun was too bright, casting sharp shadows across the yard. I shouldn't have come to this sale, but there it was, a fuzzy outline of a memory. The bear’s fur, once soft, was now coarse and worn, but its eyes stared back, unchanging. I hesitated, the world suddenly too loud, too crowded. What if I touch it and all the memories rush back, the good and the unbearable? The tag fluttered in the breeze, asking for a new home. I could walk away, pretend I never saw it. But my hand moved on its own, fingers trembling as they reached out. What if this bear, this piece of my past, brings back things best left forgotten?
